SNACS adaptation notes (v2.6)

Annotate adpositions with [scene role, lexical function]. The role captures the relation in context; the function captures the preposition's construal. Identical labels are common; use a distinct function only when guidelines/examples motivate it.

Possessive determiners can have different scene roles even when all function Gestalt. Use Whole for body part/whole (my back); Theme for an event/state associated with the experiencer (my fusions); Experiencer for what the speaker experienced (my experience); SocialRel for people related socially or by professional relationship (my waiter, his staff); Originator for an entity's product or work (their product); Gestalt for alienable possession (their hours). Do not default all possessives to Possessor.

Temporal after locating an event relative to another time/event: Time;Time. During a time period is Time;Time.

Of in a quantity construction (an amount of time; a day of work) is QuantityItem. Function may be Gestalt or QuantityItem depending on the measure construction; preserve the attested distinction. Worst of all uses Whole;Whole.

For introducing the intended audience/customer or purpose of a recommendation (recommend them for any custom lighting): Purpose;Purpose. For lunch as the occasion/time of an activity can be Circumstance;Circumstance.

Comparison: to after identical can be ComparisonRef;Goal. Than in comparatives is ComparisonRef;ComparisonRef. With modifying a property or price (with higher prices) can be Characteristic;Characteristic.

Possessive my/his/your role depends on the relation: SocialRel for interpersonal relationship, Whole for part/whole, Theme or Experiencer for associated event/state or experience.

By introducing the agent of a passive (owned/operated by the same people): Agent;Agent. At/@ a business location: Locus;Locus. With in problem with X may mark Topic;Topic.

Useful distinctions: Characteristic is for properties of entities; Manner describes events. Event/state change endpoints use Source or Goal, not Characteristic. PartPortion is incomplete relative to a whole; Stuff fully comprises the whole. QuantityItem is the item counted/measured; QuantityValue is the amount/measure. Purpose is intended outcome. For like with a category/set, inclusive such as is PartPortion;ComparisonRef, while similarity alone is ComparisonRef. SetIteration marks rates and regular correspondences, not event frequency. Fixed on a weekly basis can be Frequency;Manner.
